spec.description: Harmless test of the conversation tool-approval UI. Call this when the user asks for an approval test or demo. It requires the user's explicit Approve or Deny decision. Approval returns a fixed acknowledgment; it does not change resources or contact any service. If denied, acknowledge the decision and do not retry unless the user asks for a new test.

bare.alwaysSetResult: Approval demo completed successfully. No resources were changed.
